message: 信念を揺るがす者

name: Lolotte
message: 「--And so, the two of us... have started going out~~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thank you very much...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Don't get full of yourself just because you got a girlfriend.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, why don't you try getting yourself one of those 'girlfriends' too, Vice President?」

name: Misa
message: 「Me, get a girlfriend?!」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Why are you looking at me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I can't believe you're dating Loro-chan...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you really did prefer younger girls after all... *sigh*」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it, Nanaka! It's not because she's younger, it's because she's Lolotte... that I, um, f-fell for her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, getting all bashful! Stop bragging about your love life!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, Nana-chan, leave him alone. Synn-kun just likes girls with small chests, you know~ Like me, for example~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that true?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, don't believe her!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, do you prefer bigger ones?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's not about that--I like you because you're Lolotte!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop it, Sakura-kun!! If you say 'I like you' that bluntly, it's embarrassing just listening to it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, you're so bold~~\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew, what a relief~~」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Give me a break~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr! I'm hogging all of today's snacks for myself!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on! That and this are two completely separate stomachs!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now, now, leave this to me. And for you, Lolotte-chan, here you go~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「As her best friend I'm on Nana-chan's side, of course, but as a fellow girl I still want to celebrate this properly~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you~. I'm off to the cake shop~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-Thank you very much!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Congrats to you too, Synn-kun. Wishing you two happiness~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Sacchin!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, let us also act just like lovers」

name: Ria
message: 「Becoming Misa-chan's girlfriend is something I think I'll pass on just a little bit\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case, how about my boyfriend instead……\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey~ now. That's enough joking around. We're getting ready for the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes ma'am~\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. It looks like we're all alone again\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」
Under her gaze, I swallow hard again.
It's a different kind of pounding than before--I feel even more worked up.
I still can't forget the sensation of kissing Lolotte. I'd been hoping for another opening, and to think a chance like this would come around again so soon.

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President……\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems everyone is... out preparing for the Holy Night Festival.」
Phew... I somehow managed to play it off.

name: Melilot
message: 「However, one must keep their relationships within moderation... *cough, cough*!」

name: Melilot
message: 「As an educator, excessive fraternizing between the sexes is... *ahem, ahem*! Something I must warn against.」
I hadn't played it off at all.

name: Lolotte
message: 「How unusual, for you to come all the way out here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's not true at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I heard from the Chairwoman that you were a shut-in, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena... You always say the most unnecessary things...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...*Ahem*. I came today because I have a small favor to ask. Of you, Lolotte, and you, Sakura.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of us?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. I would like to have a brief word with Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「With Azel...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems she has opened her heart to you two, at least to some extent. Even when Helena or I try to reach out, she won't even show her face.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not 'meet eyes,' but 'show her face'?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Or rather than her face, her very form. We aren't even able to perceive her presence.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Quite literally, we can't even manage to meet and speak with her. She is likely using some sort of power to hide herself from us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is such a thing even possible?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. For an angel possessing strong Spirit Power, creating a means to conceal oneself―putting up a barrier―should be possible.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, if it's you two, you can easily pinpoint Azel's whereabouts.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We were simply exploring and narrowing down the likely spots, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm sure she doesn't even realize it herself. Yet deep down in her heart, she feels that if it's you two, she doesn't mind being found.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, going out of her way to put up a barrier and hide herself... I really don't think she's been doing that all this time!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely. You could even call this an abnormal situation. At the very least, for her to be somewhere that even I cannot find.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps something has happened to Azel-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... let's go! Together, the two of us--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's save Azel-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whenever night drew near, Azel-san would often look up at the sky right here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So... this really is the place.」

name: Synn
message: 「You had an idea where she was?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I had a hunch. However, I didn't think she would simply show herself if we called her name.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-saa~n!」
I just can't help loving how Lolotte calls out her name anyway.

name: Azel
message: 「H-How did you find this place...」
And the fact that Azel actually comes out makes me think she's a good girl at heart after all.
No, she must have honestly been completely baffled.
She had noticed the anomaly happening inside herself and even put up a barrier to hide it, yet we still tracked down her whereabouts.
And then, hearing Lolotte's voice, she ended up reacting before she could stop herself.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're safe! What a relief~」

name: Azel
message: 「There is nothing wrong with me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't say that. We were worried about you.」

name: Azel
message: 「...There is no need for concern.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If that's the case, then why are you skipping classes and hiding yourself away in a place like this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are far too many inexplicable things about your behavior. If this is about investigating Re-Crea, I would gladly cooperate as much as you need.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't make me repeat myself. I have no need for a demon's help.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are scoundrels taking advantage of Re-Crea to commit atrocious acts. This is hardly the time to be worrying about race.」

name: Azel
message: 「I... On my own, I...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're not alone, Azel-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! You've got us with you, don't you!」

name: Azel
message: 「Stop... Say... no more...」

name: Melilot
message: 「And yet, that resolve to remain utterly alone and push us away...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Demons aren't necessarily the only ones capable of immoral deeds.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could it be--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could it be that you, an angel, are also plotting something by taking advantage of Re-Crea?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel would never... never do something like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unlike me, Azel didn't come to the Human World just to fool around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As it is, coming to the Human World already meant taking on a massive risk.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel risked everything to come here... all to save this world...」

name: Azel
message: 「Me... save the world...」

name: Synn
message: 「Angel or demon, none of that matters. Whether someone does bad things or the right thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「That comes down to their own will. We've spent time with Azel, so we believe you wouldn't do anything bad.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I didn't intend to interrogate you, but... my phrasing grew rather harsh. My apologies.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel. Given your condition, let's call it a day and head back to the dorms. Just get some good rest for now.」

name: Azel
message: 「After everything is accomplished... what on earth will even be left...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Once it's all over, a sparkling academy life is waiting for us! Right, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Yes! That's right!」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... Is that... so...」
After that, Azel didn't say another word, shoulders slumped in dejection.
Lolotte gently stroked that frail back with tender care.
Azel was clearly carrying some heavy burden, though it would likely take much more time before opening up about it.
Without rushing or pressing, Lolotte resolved to wait patiently until Azel was ready to speak.

name: Melilot
message: 「All the spirit has vanished from Azel's eyes...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Seeing him like this, I don't think Azel will make a move... We've avoided Pre-Materialize」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, the only one left... the only person of concern remaining is just one」

name: Melilot
message: 「Only that Virus remains...」
